method: 68's part (height 20) plus a flat hem on the flange top edge: 180 deg bend, inner radius = hem gap 0.01 / 2, outer 2.505, about (y 2.505, z 20), folded toward +y (inside); hem leg 8 - (0.005 + 2.5) = 5.495: y 2.51..5.01, z 14.505..20; extrusion along x 100
note: SolidCraft conventions: hem gap 0.01 mm (rule hem_gap) between the hem's leg and the face it folds over, hem length measured to the outer face of the hem bend (top at z 22.505), hem folds over the flange's inner face.
